description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of tasks related to generative AI in journalism as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It is divided into two segments: the larger segment, colored in reddish-pink, accounts for 83.2% and is labeled “Article generation”; the smaller segment, in yellow, represents 16.8% and is labeled “generation,” though the full label appears to be cut off or abbreviated. The chart uses a central white space with the title “Task Type” in bold black text, and percentage values are displayed directly next to their respective segments. The visual design emphasizes the dominance of article generation as the primary task type, with the smaller segment visually offset to the right, possibly to draw attention to its secondary role. No legend is present, and the chart relies on direct labeling for clarity.
